senses.gloss: to dig, cut out (of the sucket), hollow out.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 4:3">Mikv. IV, 3</cite> <he>החוֹטֵט בצינור וכ׳</he> if one makes a cavity in a water pipe for the deposit of pebbles.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34:10">Gen. R. s. 34</cite> <he>היה חוטט את וכ׳</he> the embryo would cut its way through &c.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 24b:18">Kidd. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>וחֲטָטָהּ</he> and he (the master) cut it (the eye) out.
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:2">M. Kat. I, 2</cite> <he>וחוֹטְטִין אותן</he> and you may clean the wells.

Ib. 5ᵃ ח׳ … ואין חופרין וכ׳ you may clean …, but not dig (deepen) &c. [Ib. ולא חוטטין לתוכן you must not rake pebbles into them; v., however vers. Ms. M., Rabb. D. S. a. l.]—Y. ib. 80ᵇ bot. חוטטין אותן גרפין לון וכ׳ (not חוטטן) ḥot’tin means ‘they rake them’, as we read (Mikv. l. c.).

senses.gloss: to take sheaves out with a rake.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 1:8">Succ. I, 8</cite> <he>החוטט בגדיש וכ׳</he> if one takes sheaves out of a stack, so as to form a shed (Succah). Ib. 15ᵃ

senses.gloss: to rake. Y. Sabb. III, beg. 5ᶜ צריך לחַטֵּט ביד וכ׳ he must rake (coals and ashes out of the oven) with a handle, which proves that he must clean thoroughly.

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 7:2">Tosef. Mikv. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 8:2">VIII</cite>), 2 <he>אוצין צריך לחטט</he> Var. (ed. Zuck. <he>לחַטְחֵט</he>) if the holes in the baskets are filled up with grapes &c., one must clean them by picking.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 18a:2">B. Kam. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>תרנגולין שהיו מְחַטְּטִין וכ׳</he> chickens that picked on the rope of a bucket.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 8:30">Tosef. B. Mets. VIII, 30</cite> <he>שמְחַטְּטִין את וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>שמְחַטְחֲטִין</he>) for they pick holes in the walls.

senses.gloss: (with אחר) to dig after, to trace with the knife.
<cite ref="H00606">same</cite>. Y. Orl. III, 63ᵃ <he>מצוי לחַטְחֵט אחריו</he> it is likely that they dig after it (to take it out of the ground); a. e. (v. supra).

units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 24b:20">Kidd. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>נֶחְטְטָה עינה</he> if the bird’s eye was picked out; <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 7:5">Zeb. VII, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Zevachim 68b">68ᵇ</cite>) Ar. (ed. <he>נסמית</he>).
<cite ref="Yevamot 63b:11">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>מתים מִתְחַטְּטִין</he> the dead are exhumed (by the Guebres).

senses.gloss: to be cut (of jewels), to be polished, glisten.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 12a">Meg. 12ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>בה̇ט̇</he>, <cite ref="Esther 1:6">Esth. I, 6</cite>) <he>אב̇נים שמִתְח̇וֹטְֹטוֹת על בעליהן וי״א אב̇נים המְח̇וֹטְֹטוֹת לעינים במקומן</he> Ms. F. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5) stones which glisten on those who wear them, and some say, Stones which dazzle the eyes in the place where they are found.
